notation.study: Already returned four-key object; this preparation did not call the API.

available_fields.name: cycle six signed lower-body force scalars
available_fields.direction: Fx/+x and Fy/+y in the saved global axes; model/medium ON the fixed lower-half workpiece, negative internal weak force.
available_fields.scope: field is one of total_body_Fx_N,total_body_Fy_N,material_body_Fx_N,material_body_Fy_N,regularization_body_Fx_N,regularization_body_Fy_N. Keep raw leg/target/d/SHA/source, do not mirror or rescale.

available_fields.name: same six scalars at selected peak
available_fields.direction: Same ON-body global-axis convention as cycle row.
available_fields.scope: Current global12/loading1.06 only; old accepted1 versus new accepted12. Reader checks all original37 fields, not a new mechanical pass.

available_fields.name: per-node ON-body vectors
available_fields.direction: c in total/material/regularization; a0=Fx, a1=Fy; each vector is minus the corresponding stored global internal vector at that node.
available_fields.scope: 565 original nodes per source; node_ids[i]/coordinates_mm[i]/masks[g][i] use the same positional i. regularization is the saved Hu weak-force contribution, not a separate pressure field.

available_fields.name: whole fixed lower-body resultants
available_fields.direction: Signed ON-body resultant along global x/y, no mirror doubling.
available_fields.scope: Original per-component fsum of all fixed-body node forces; current map only references saved values and does not rerun fsum.

available_fields.name: original total holding reaction
available_fields.direction: Saved reaction acting ON the model to hold the fixed body; opposite to ON-body total by the saved convention.
available_fields.scope: In the current returned nodal object, there is only one original total holding vector, not a dict by material/Hu and not a saved per-node holding array. The producer source NPZ/global arrays do contain support_reaction; they were not opened here. Component sign reversal is algebraic bookkeeping, not an independent measurement.

available_fields.name: four original mask resultants
available_fields.direction: Signed ON-body global-axis sum over the original nodal mask.
available_fields.scope: Four mutually exclusive nodal categories; not a face-traction integral. physical_only71,cut_only35,physical_and_cut2,interior457. physical/cut edge-node sets separately overlap at2 nodes.

available_fields.name: original moments
available_fields.direction: Saved z moment: sum((x-x0)*Fy-(y-y0)*Fx), positive counterclockwise in global xy.
available_fields.scope: Read the original nodal.moment_origin_mm; do not assume circle centre or shift the origin. Group moment selector adds groups[g] before moment_about_origin_Nmm. No new integral in this map.

available_fields.name: within-alpha existing loading/unloading force differences
available_fields.unit: N for the six force fields
available_fields.direction: within_value_key is loading_value/unloading_value/unloading_minus_loading, exactly as stored in both existing cycle reports.
available_fields.scope: 7 original pairs per alpha. Zero reference raw leg remains origin; loading_value is a column name, not proof of a loading zero state. No recalculation or equality/return criterion.

available_fields.name: cross-alpha existing scalar force differences
available_fields.unit: N for the six force fields
available_fields.direction: baseline_value/new_value/new_minus_baseline in the saved global ON-body convention.
available_fields.scope: 20 original-target pairs; keep global_index/display_branch/d and both source SHA. The existing13 metric set also contains nonforce quantities with their own units. cross_value_key is baseline_value/new_value/new_minus_baseline, exactly as stored.

available_fields.name: cross-alpha existing node force pairs
available_fields.scope: 565 node pairs and3390 component differences already stored. Preserve node_id/coordinates_mm/masks and original raw indices; no new force extrema, ratio, projection or difference. cross_value_key is baseline_value/new_value/new_minus_baseline, exactly as stored.

available_fields.name: cross-alpha existing group force pairs
available_fields.scope: 4 group pairs/24 stored component differences; p is selected by group name, not assumed contact status. cross_value_key is baseline_value/new_value/new_minus_baseline, exactly as stored.

available_fields.name: cross-alpha existing whole-force pairs
available_fields.scope: 6 stored component differences. No original per-component holding-reaction difference or new moment-difference selector is claimed. cross_value_key is baseline_value/new_value/new_minus_baseline, exactly as stored.

available_fields.name: node identity and masks
available_fields.unit: dimensionless ID; coordinates_mm are mm; masks are bool
available_fields.direction: Original global ID, not original_target_index or local accepted-state index.
available_fields.scope: Coordinate selector replaces node_ids with coordinates_mm; mask selector is masks[g][i]; edges.closed/physical/cut hold global node-ID endpoint pairs.

available_fields.name: light report association and original units
available_fields.unit: d_mm mm; alpha dimensionless; source identity indices/SHA are metadata
available_fields.scope: Light report has metadata/selectors, not nodal vector payload. units are study.report.cycles[s].original_task.units; report.qualification preserves source declarations, missing stays missing.

guards: No local face normal or pressure/traction is reconstructed from a global nodal vector.

In the current returned nodal object, only total holding is exposed as an original saved reaction vector; material/Hu sign reversals are algebraic bookkeeping. This does not deny support_reaction exists in original producer arrays.
Saved forces are already labelled N, moments N mm, coordinates mm; do not multiply thickness or a mirror factor in this map. No force_scale_per_length field occurs in either current returned report.
Material and regularization/total vectors are separately saved; no decomposition, fsum, moment, mirror or new metric was evaluated.
Four nodal masks partition nodes; physical/cut edge node sets overlap separately. Physical-only is not a declaration of contact.
The moment origin is the saved origin, default body-node mean in source, not necessarily circle centre.
Source/alpha/global/leg/d/SHA identity is retained; identical origin SHA cannot transfer qualification.
No report layer or default HF source was added; these two files document definitions/selectors only.
read_scope: Three listed Python source files, existing light report, and the two already-known ordinary comparison dictionaries for field-path presence only; no original arrays/node JSON/cycle/history files, API, media or Git.
